ir.name: builder_all_pairs_tiezone_gap_linear
ir.intuition: Filter pairs by objective margin (> epsilon) and weight them proportionally to linear gap to emphasize clearer pairwise preferences
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape: (B, N)
    epsilon = 1e-4
    diff = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]  # shape: (B, N, N)
    tiezone_mask = (abs(diff) >= epsilon)
    winner_mask = diff < -epsilon
    mask = winner_mask & tiezone_mask
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    gap = (-diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]).clamp(min=0.0)
    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=gap,
        meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_tiezone_gap_linear'}
    )

ir.name: weighted_advantage_exp_margin_logsigmoid_scaled_weighted_mean_loss_v5
ir.intuition: Adjusted the margin computation to depend directly on the advantage_gap scaled by a smooth exponential sigmoid mapping, rather than on the mean advantage. This increases sensitivity to local variations rather than just a global average, addressing the insensitivity to objective perturbations. Also, added a small learnable margin floor by adding a constant to the margin for stability and ensured margin and normalization are strictly positive. This adjustment enhances gradient signal responsiveness to advantage_gap variations, improving objective sensitivity while retaining original structure and stability.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon=1e-6
adv_norm = maximum(norm(advantage_gap), epsilon)
margin = exp(clamp(sigmoid(advantage_gap), 0, 1)) + 0.1
x_raw = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / adv_norm
x = margin * x_raw
x_clamped = clamp(x, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x_clamped)
loss_weighted = loss * weight
return sum(loss_weighted) / maximum(sum(weight), epsilon)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = 1e-6
    adv_norm = ops.maximum(ops.norm(advantage_gap), epsilon)
    margin = ops.add(ops.exp(ops.clamp(ops.sigmoid(advantage_gap), 0.0, 1.0)), 0.1)
    x_raw = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), adv_norm)
    x = ops.mul(margin, x_raw)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    loss_weighted = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    loss_mean = ops.div(ops.sum(loss_weighted), ops.maximum(ops.sum(weight), epsilon))
    return loss_mean
